consequence.statement: The `cilium-dbg status --verbose` health data layout differs (reporter leaf for non-leaf components, sorted branches); nothing is stated to fail.

assertion.statement: The output of `cilium-dbg status --verbose` health data changes: non-leaf component health may appear under a leaf named `reporter`, and tree branches are sorted by fully qualified health status identifier.
